title: 彗·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 深色长发衬着苍白沉思面容，飘逸的蓝绿画师长袍层次舒展。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Hwei is a slender adult Ionian male artist with very long dark hair, a pale contemplative face, and flowing painter's robes in muted blue-green tones. Preserve the broad signature brush and hanging pigment accessories while fully covering his torso with layered opaque garments and his legs with trousers and boots. The brush is held lowered and inactive, without threatening ink creatures or a spell gesture.
art_direction.scene: A closer three-quarter study with all essential anatomy and props included, expressive head and strongly varied line weight. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: ink blue, jade gray, lilac pencil shadow hair, narrow amber light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
